description: Highest-priority mate rule. It consumes the branch-owned transition produced by caption_facts: delivered, preserved, missed, allowed, or already_lost. The renderer never infers direction from an evaluation sign or from a mate found in the other branch. Exact mate distance is rendered only when the stored legal line proves it; an eval-only mate has no invented count.

fact_glossary.best_move_san: SAN of the verified best move
fact_glossary.ply: Number of moves by the mating side, or null when the stored line does not prove the distance
fact_glossary.mate_transition: Branch-owned result from the mover's perspective: delivered, preserved, missed, allowed, or already_lost
fact_glossary.delivered_on_this_move: true when this move is checkmate
fact_glossary.mover_delivers: true when the side that just moved retains the forced mate
fact_glossary.mover_is_user: true if the user just moved
fact_glossary.mate_already_on_board: true when the opponent still forces mate after the mover's best defense
fact_glossary.mate_lesson: Which lesson this mate-allowing move should teach, decided by services/mate_lesson.mate_lesson_id from board facts alone. One of back_rank, in_check, opponent_plan, mate_threatened, win_a_piece, free_pawn, castle, give_air, scan. The ORDER lives in that module and the WORDS live here, so neither the game review nor /admin/detector-review writes prose of its own.

variants.delivered: {played_san}. Checkmate. When the king is exposed, calculate every check to the end.
variants.user_misses_mate_p1: {played_san} misses mate next move. {best_move_san} was the move. Before moving, check every forcing move: checks, captures, and threats.
variants.user_misses_mate_pN: {played_san} misses mate in {ply}. {best_move_san} was the move. Before moving, check every forcing move: checks, captures, and threats.
variants.user_misses_mate_no_count: {played_san} misses a forced win. {best_move_san} was the move. Before moving, check every forcing move: checks, captures, and threats.
variants.user_misses_mate_bare: {played_san} misses a forced win. Before moving, check every forcing move: checks, captures, and threats.
variants.opp_misses_mate_p1: {played_san} misses mate next move. You get another chance. Use that chance to make your king safe.
variants.opp_misses_mate_pN: {played_san} misses mate in {ply}. You get another chance. Use that chance to make your king safe.
variants.opp_misses_mate_no_count: {played_san} misses a forced win. You get another chance. Use that chance to make your king safe.
variants.user_forces_p1: {played_san}. Forces mate next move. When the king is exposed, calculate every check to the end.
variants.user_forces_pN: {played_san}. Forces mate in {ply}. When the king is exposed, calculate every check to the end.
variants.user_forces_noplycount: {played_san}. Wins by force. When the king is exposed, calculate every check to the end.
variants.opp_forces_p1: {played_san}. Opp threatens mate next move. Before moving, calculate every enemy check to the end.
variants.opp_forces_pN: {played_san}. Opp threatens mate in {ply}. Before moving, calculate every enemy check to the end.
variants.opp_forces_noplycount: {played_san}. Opp is winning by force. Before moving, calculate every enemy check to the end.
variants.mate_on_for_user_p1: {played_san}. Their move leaves mate next move for you. When the king is exposed, calculate every check to the end.
variants.mate_on_for_user_pN: {played_san}. Their move leaves mate in {ply} for you. When the king is exposed, calculate every check to the end.
variants.mate_on_for_user_bare: {played_san}. Their move leaves you a forced win. When the king is exposed, calculate every check to the end.
variants.user_allows_p1: {played_san} allows mate next move. Before moving, calculate every enemy check to the end.
variants.user_allows_pN: {played_san} allows mate in {ply}. Before moving, calculate every enemy check to the end.
variants.user_allows_pv: {played_san} lets {threat_move} in — your opponent now has a forced win. Before moving, calculate every enemy check to the end.
variants.user_allows_bare: {played_san} allows a forced win for your opponent. Before moving, calculate every enemy check to the end.
variants.user_already_lost_p1: {played_san} cannot stop mate next move; it was already forced. Make them prove every move.
variants.user_already_lost_pN: {played_san} cannot stop mate in {ply}; it was already forced. Make them prove every move.
variants.user_already_lost: {played_san} cannot stop the forced win already on the board. Make them prove every move.
variants.opp_already_lost_p1: {played_san} cannot stop your mate next move. Calculate every check to the end.
variants.opp_already_lost_pN: {played_san} cannot stop your mate in {ply}. Calculate every check to the end.
variants.opp_already_lost: {played_san} cannot stop your forced win. Calculate every check to the end.
variants.user_allows_back_rank: Your own pawns sealed the first rank and left your king nowhere to go -- that is a back-rank mate. Push one early to make air, long before a rook gets there.
variants.user_allows_in_check: You were in check and a way out existed. The first move that stops a check is not always the one that survives -- play each one out.
variants.user_allows_opponent_plan: Those pieces did not arrive by accident -- every move your opponent makes is part of a plan. Find theirs before you follow your own.
variants.user_allows_mate_threatened: Mate was already on the board before you moved, and you played elsewhere. Before your own plan, ask what they can do to your king right now.
variants.user_allows_win_a_piece: When you are about to win a piece, check your own king first.
variants.user_allows_free_pawn: A free pawn is never worth a turn spent away from your king.
variants.user_allows_castle: Castle before they get two pieces pointing at your king.
variants.user_allows_give_air: Give your king a square to run to before it needs one.
variants.user_allows_scan: Look at what is already aimed at your king before you move.
